item.title: Federal employees file complaint against Trump administration’s ban on gender-affirming care
item.description: The Trump administration is facing a new legal complaint from a group of government employees who are affected by a new policy going into effect Thursday that eliminates coverage for gender-affirming care in federal health insurance programs.
